newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq welcomes British stand on Turkish attack.
newsitem.headline: Iraq welcomes British stand on Turkish attack.

text.p: Iraq on Thursday welcomed what it said were "positive" remarks by new British Foreign Office minister on the Turkish army incursion into northern Iraq.

"We have noticed with importance the text of the positive statement of Mr Doug Henderson...on the Turkish military incursion in northern Iraq," Iraq's Foreign Minister Mohammad Saeed al-Sahaf said in a statement to the Iraqi News Agency.

"This statement expresses an objective point of view toward the Turkish incursions and it encourages us to express hope that British policy would view other (Iraqi) issues with the same objectivity," Sahaf said.
Turkish troops, tanks and air power pounded rebel Kurdish positions inside northern Iraq in the second day of a sweep through the remote mountainous region.

Henderson said in a statement on Wednesday that Britain supported Turkey's territorial integrity but was worried by the incursion. "We are urging the Turks not to exceed measures necessary to protect these interests," he said.
Iraq's official media on Sunday urged the new British government of Labour Prime Minister Tony Blair to change London's policy toward Iraq.
